description: An apply tells what the call did to each vendor key. A status tells the state of each stored key. No answer holds a vendor key.

shodan.description: It holds the answer for the Shodan key.

result.description: Present only on an apply. It is saved, deleted, rejected when the vendor refused the key, vendor_unavailable when the vendor gave no usable answer or limited the rate, or unchanged when the call named nothing for this vendor.

configured.description: Present only on an apply. true when a key is stored after the call.

retry_after_seconds.description: Present only on an apply, on vendor_unavailable with a wait above 0. It is the wait the vendor asked for.

state.description: Present only on a status. It is working or rejected when the vendor accepted or refused the stored key just now, vendor_unavailable when the key could not be checked, or not_configured when no key is stored.

abuseipdb.description: It holds the answer for the AbuseIPDB key.

manage_url.description: Present only on an apply called with an API key, not with a manage link. It is a new manage link where a human can save keys, and it is valid for 15 minutes. It is a credential: show it only to the key's owner. null when none could be written.

expires_in_seconds.description: Present only on a status, which is called with a manage link. It counts the seconds that link has left, 0 or more.

charged.description: Credits this call cost; 0 for a free tool.

remaining.description: Credits left in the budget window. Absent when not paid from a credit budget.
